name: Paired Seals of Private Communication
body:
School divination; Level bloodlord 2, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (250 gp worth of ink used to inscribe the paired seals to be used for the spell)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target you and 1 creature touched
Duration 10 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You lay down a pair of magically entangled seals (one each for you and the touched creature) that enable mental communication. The focus of this spell is the pair of permanently inscribed seals on you and the touched creature (effects like erase can remove the inscribed seals).

The bearer of any one of the paired seals can mentally transmit their thoughts to the bearer of the other paired seal as per the sending spell. Unlike a regular sending spell, the bearer of a paired seal can transmit up to 250 words (or a single page of images) per round and the range of this sending is 5 miles per caster level (it cannot cross planar boundaries). A user cannot have more than one ongoing instance of paired seals of private communication active on them.

Creatures under the effects of paired seals of private communication on them suffer a -2 penalty to Perception checks due to the mental strain imposed by the spell.
